entries.name: Mercor
products: Tests of professional work, with task datasets for AI agents.
Tests extended professional work across several applications.
Tests accounting work across applications. Developed with Ramp.
Tests software integration and observability (checking what software does while it runs). Developed with Cognition.
Builds AI agents for business tasks.
Licenses data from businesses’ day-to-day operations.
entries.summary: Connects specialists with AI training and testing work. It also helps businesses put AI programs to work.

entries.name: Snorkel AI
products: Specialist training data and reinforcement learning environments (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores).
Combines expert work with AI quality checks.
AI agents built for business applications.
entries.summary: Builds specialist training data and tools to test AI. It also creates practice tasks for AI systems.

entries.name: Handshake AI
products: A network of professionals who create training data and test AI models.
entries.summary: Brings professionals into AI training and testing work. Their expertise also shapes practice tasks for AI.

entries.name: micro1
products: Tests advanced AI models and provides reinforcement learning environments (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores).
Tests AI agents in live use and helps improve their performance.
Training data from experts demonstrating real-world tasks.
entries.summary: Uses specialist knowledge to create AI training data and realistic practice tasks. It also tests how AI performs those tasks.

entries.name: Scale AI
products: Training data and annotation (labels added to data so models can learn).
AI applications for work inside businesses.
entries.summary: Provides expert training data and AI testing. It also builds AI applications for businesses and governments.

entries.name: Turing
products: Verified specialists produce coding and reasoning data for advanced AI models.
Training tasks with prompts and scoring tools.
Specialists who contribute to AI data work.
Custom AI agents and deployment support for business tasks.
entries.summary: Uses specialist knowledge to build AI training data and practice tasks. It also helps businesses use AI in their existing work.

entries.name: Labelbox
products: Training environments where experts grade and evaluate model behavior.
Simulates business applications and data for agents training in Horizon.
AI agents for business tasks, with output scoring to improve specialist models.
Robotics datasets from first-person recordings and remotely controlled demonstrations.
Qualified experts create preference data (ratings that show which responses people prefer). They also grade step-by-step task records.
entries.summary: Builds practice tasks and expert feedback for AI training. Its business software runs AI programs that carry out tasks.

entries.name: Prime Intellect
products: A platform for reinforcement learning (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores) and further model training.
Environments for model training and evaluation.
Isolated environments for training and evaluation.
Open model research from Prime Intellect.
entries.summary: Provides computing resources and tools for teams that train and run their own AI systems.

entries.name: Abundant
products: Simulation and model-training work for coding and physical science. Also covers recursive self-improvement (models working to improve their own capabilities) and alignment (guiding models toward intended and safe behavior).
Turns code changes into verified coding tasks. Rebuilds a buggy starting point from working code to reduce errors caused by broken tests.
Tests extended software work, including rebuilding libraries and complete applications. Also covers machine-learning engineering.
Creates difficult proof tasks in Lean (software that checks whether mathematical proofs are correct). Uses isolated checks to detect attempts to game rewards.
entries.summary: Builds simulated tasks and training data for AI programs that carry out work.

entries.name: AfterQuery
products: Professional assignments based on files. Tasks require analysis across several steps, with graded outputs.
Experts write tasks from private business codebases. Automated tests check the results.
Successful action records from command-line tasks (text commands used to operate a computer). Tasks run in isolated environments and earn rewards from tests.
Service tasks with several steps. Checks confirm whether calls to software tools work correctly.

Training tasks using connected software tools or browser and desktop applications. Expert action records and grading support reinforcement learning (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores).
Examples teach desired responses, with comparisons showing which answers experts prefer. Expert grading rules are paired with automated checks.
Identifies gaps in a model’s abilities and prepares training data. Further training adapts a specialist model or agent for deployment.
Atlas helps label and organize data. Raine Search finds past deals using everyday-language queries. Deployed for a named client; general self-service availability is undisclosed.
entries.summary: Turns professional expertise into AI training data and practice tasks.

entries.name: Bespoke Labs
products: Simulates company systems using real codebases and small connected services. Provides tools to build, run and improve these environments.
Uses task feedback to improve prompts and model behavior.
Prepares synthetic data (examples generated by software rather than collected directly) for further training and structured extraction.
Open research on preparing data for reasoning models.
Contributes tests of agent work in command-line environments (text-based interfaces for running commands on computers).
Returns probabilities for allowed answers. Nimble-v4 and Nimble-v4-max support grading and agent decisions, including routing tasks.
entries.summary: Builds realistic practice tasks for AI programs that carry out work. Its tools help teams train and test those programs.

entries.name: Polymath
products: Simulated working systems whose data and tools change over time. Outcomes can be checked.
Tests software work from start to finish inside a simulated company, including deployment and monitoring.
entries.summary: Builds simulated software tasks that train AI to complete extended engineering work.

entries.name: Proximal
products: Turns work records and outputs into tests of model abilities and targeted training data.
Tests extended technical work in implementation and performance. Tasks also cover science, visual reasoning and AI research.
A testing system designed to keep agents working within a 20-hour task budget.
entries.summary: Turns records of human and AI work into training data. Its tests measure AI performance on demanding technical tasks.

entries.name: Trajectory Labs, PBC
products: Experts design new attacks to test weaknesses in advanced agents and their cybersecurity safeguards.
Tasks and attack examples reveal failures and help train safer behavior.
A benchmark developed with Meta for prompt injection (malicious instructions that try to redirect an AI). Uses a fixed set of attacks generated by Trajectory Labs’ proprietary attacker.
entries.summary: Builds tests that look for harmful AI behavior. It also creates practice tasks for AI training.

entries.name: Refresh
products: Realistic, connected applications for business tasks, including electronic health records.
Expert-built tasks for modeling and animation, including rigging and materials. Also covers physics simulation, with versioned checks of results.
A tool for testing computer use across models, contributed to Harbor.
Step-by-step records of agent actions, with benchmark results.
entries.summary: Creates software practice tasks for AI, including Blender (software for making and animating three-dimensional scenes).

entries.name: Surge AI
products: Coding tasks for training and testing AI agents (software that takes actions to complete a task).
Grading rules and checks for model outputs.
Human feedback for model training (people rate responses to guide model training).
Supervised fine-tuning (models learn from examples of desired responses).
Experts assess model responses and behavior.
Post-training (additional training to improve an existing model).
entries.summary: Uses expert work to train and test AI. It also builds practice tasks for AI systems.

entries.name: Quesma
products: Analyzes coding-agent sessions and costs. The reviewed product has an early-access waitlist.
An open-source collector that saves agent-session transcripts in the user’s Amazon S3 storage.
These four benchmarks (shared tests for comparing model performance) cover specific engineering or puzzle tasks.
entries.summary: Examines how AI writes code to explain costs and find failures.

entries.name: Datacurve
products: Extended tasks with natural instructions and realistic tools. Measures partial progress across software and data science, plus cybersecurity, machine learning and research.
Ready-made, reviewed datasets. Custom work includes supervised fine-tuning (models learn from examples of desired responses), expert task records and evaluations.
Original engineering tasks written from scratch. Handwritten checks assess behavior; tasks are not adapted from existing code changes.
Pays for approved technical challenge submissions. Mars covers software engineering; Eris covers machine learning. Monte covers data science.
entries.summary: Recruits experienced developers to create coding data and test AI coding tools.

entries.name: BenchFlow
products: Tests whether reusable instructions improve agents’ task performance.
Replicas of Gmail and Calendar, plus Docs, Drive and Slack, that retain changes between actions. Scores capability and safety separately.
Lets coding agents operate simulated robots through shell commands.
Community environments tested using a fixed training recipe. Training runs are currently paused.
Open-source tools for running and scoring agents in test environments.
entries.summary: Builds practice tasks and tests for AI programs that carry out work. It also provides tools to run those tests.

entries.name: G2i
products: Engineers build human-feedback systems through teams embedded with clients or managed projects.
Supervised fine-tuning datasets (examples that teach models to produce desired responses).
Custom training environments with evaluations and grading rules.
entries.summary: Supplies experienced engineers who build AI practice tasks and training data. Their work also includes AI testing.

entries.name: A.Team
products: Teams build business AI agents that the client owns.
Senior engineering teams build and run business AI systems.
Engineers build task evaluations and systems for further model training.
Technical specialists join hourly or ongoing work, including advisory engagements.
entries.summary: Places experienced engineering teams inside businesses to build and run AI systems that carry out work.

entries.name: HackerRank Bench
products: Private, extended engineering tasks. Hand-built checks score how the agent behaves.
Extended engineering tasks in environments that can be reproduced.
Reinforcement learning environments (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores).
entries.summary: Sells software that tests developers’ skills. Its AI business also supplies coding data and practice tasks for AI.

entries.name: Pareto AI
products: Captures specialist judgment in medicine and law. Also covers STEM, finance, software and the humanities.
Experts register and are matched to projects. Matching is reviewed on an ongoing basis.
Measures how efficiently models learn across repeated scientific design tasks. Also assesses their final results.
Tests conversational emotional intelligence using participants’ own ratings.
entries.summary: Uses specialists’ judgment to create AI training data and tests.

entries.name: Ooak Data
products: Removes identifying details from connected company communications, documents and tools. Preserves their relationships and the company’s structure.
Tasks with several steps, based on real company work and calibrated against advanced models.
Acquires connected business datasets. Handles extraction and delivery while removing identifying details across sources.
Instructions for connecting and exporting company data. Named in the official first product-manager job description.
entries.summary: Turns real business work into AI practice tasks while removing identifying details from the data.

entries.name: Elorian
products: An unreleased model for spatial and physical reasoning. Early access has a waitlist.
entries.summary: Researches AI systems that reason from images about physical space and design.

entries.name: Terac
products: Recruits and verifies experts for AI training programs.
Connects software directly to expert labor services.
AI screening and interviews for expert recruitment.
entries.summary: Connects verified specialists with paid research and AI training work.

entries.name: Laude Institute / Terminal-Bench
products: Open tests of agent work in command-line environments (text-based interfaces for running commands on computers). The reviewed homepage shows version 4.0.
Grants and hands-on support for research projects.
Support for research labs pursuing work over longer periods.
entries.summary: Funds public computing research and helps develop Terminal-Bench, which tests AI on practical computer tasks.

entries.name: Invisible Technologies
products: Data systems for business AI applications.
An expert network for validation work.
Tools for labeling data and evaluating models.
AI agents that automate business operations.
entries.summary: Combines expert data and AI testing with software that helps businesses automate their work.

entries.name: Toloka
products: Expert task records and human evaluation for agent training.
Coding datasets written by experts for model training.
entries.summary: Uses specialist work to create training data and test AI. It also builds practice tasks for AI systems.

entries.name: Prolific
products: Recruits verified participants for research studies.
Connects software directly to human feedback for AI training and evaluation.
Groups of experts recruited for specialist research.
Managed projects that collect human feedback and evaluate models.
entries.summary: Connects researchers and AI teams with verified participants who are paid to provide feedback.

entries.name: AIXI Labs
products: Connects mathematical theories of AI agents with practical research on model safety.
About three months of research, with supervision and computing support.
entries.summary: Studies the mathematics behind AI decision-making and ways to reduce AI risks.

entries.name: Appen
products: Human data and evaluation for post-training (additional training to improve an existing model).
A platform where contributors collect and label data.
entries.summary: Uses people to prepare and check AI training data. Its work includes speech data and AI programs that act in the physical world.

entries.name: Giskard
products: Deliberate attacks test security risks and failures specific to a business.
Automated checks and expert review assess model behavior.
A platform for businesses to test and review AI.
entries.summary: Tests business AI software for security weaknesses and unreliable answers.

entries.name: Alinia AI
products: Models trained to judge outputs against institutional and legal policies.
Applies policy checks while AI systems are running.
Expert review and audit records support deployment into live use.
A specialized legal-compliance model released in October 2026.
entries.summary: Builds software that checks business AI against company rules and legal requirements.

entries.name: APTO
products: Specialists create instruction data and evaluate model quality.
entries.summary: Creates AI training data with specialist workers and its harBest software.

entries.name: RWS / TrainAI
products: Managed training data in multiple languages, with expert feedback.
A screened specialist network for AI data work.
Expert data for model training, including human feedback and carefully designed prompts.
entries.summary: Prepares AI training data in many languages. Specialists also review AI answers and test systems for harmful behavior.

entries.name: iMerit / EXL
products: Software for labeling and reviewing data, including medical images and LiDAR (laser measurements used to map three-dimensional surroundings).
Experts design tasks with several steps. They use model errors to create corrective training data.
Domain specialists create training data and evaluate model reasoning.
Managed data labeling and evaluation for healthcare and robotics, including autonomous vehicles.
entries.summary: Combines specialist workers and software to prepare AI training data and test AI systems.

entries.name: Sama
products: A dedicated workforce labels images and video, as well as 3D data.
Human review and correction of model predictions.
Human evaluation of factual accuracy and instruction following.
A quality guarantee for delivered data.
A shared workspace for data projects.
Information about how data workflows perform.
entries.summary: Uses people to label and check training data. It also tests AI performance on image and other data.

entries.name: TaskUs
products: People collect and label data. Experts also write responses for model training.
Red teaming (deliberate attacks that reveal model weaknesses) and human feedback support safer model behavior.
Digital customer experience and Trust & Safety
Outsourced customer support, plus review of content and financial crime.
Gig workers collect and label data for projects.
Experts review responses and design tests of model performance.
entries.summary: Runs customer support and content safety services for other businesses. Its AI work supplies training data and tests AI systems.
